one_liner: Meeting recording and transcription platform that captures, searches, and provides AI-powered transcripts of meetings from multiple platforms.

auth.notes: Official API uses OAuth2 (DCR_OAUTH). Access tokens generated via Enterprise Settings. Community implementations also support email/password.

evidence.snippet: Generate your access token in Otter.ai: Enterprise Settings → API → Generate Token

access.notes: Public API in beta; requires Enterprise plan; must contact Otter account manager for access. No free tier for API.

evidence.snippet: The Otter.ai public API is currently in beta and requires an Enterprise plan. Contact your Otter account manager for API access.

unknown_reasons.auth: Pages confirm OAuth2 but do not explicitly document all supported grant types (DCR_OAUTH mentioned but not fully specified).
unknown_reasons.api_surface: API style inferred from webhook and CLI evidence but not explicitly documented. Rate limits not stated in pages. Breadth estimated from 31 CLI commands, not official API documentation.
